name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 8

function.text: MAP3K8 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 8. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein phosphorylation.

function.text: MAP3K8 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 8. It is required for lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced, TLR4-mediated activation of the MAPK/ERK pathway in macrophages, thus being critical for production of the pro-inflammatory cytokine TNF (TNF) during immune responses. It participates in the regulation of T-helper cell differentiation and IFNG expression in T-cells. It transduces CD40 and TNFRSF1A signals that activate ERK in B-cells and macrophages, and thus may play a role in the regulation of immunoglobulin production.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAP3K8 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.
